explication: MLX Audio Swift is a modular MLX-based audio SDK for Apple platforms. Its principal workflows are text-to-speech generation and audio-to-text transcription; the broader product also supports language identification, voice activity and speaker analysis, speech-to-speech processing, and audio codecs/tokenizers. Core utilities support model and audio workflows. The README documents the major capabilities, while sampled sources show CLI loading and inference examples; unsampled model internals and cross-module runtime calls are not inferred here.
